 This application coming on for admission this day, the

following:
 Order

This is first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973 for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant who has been arrested relating to FIR/Crime No.1076/2023 dated 26.10.2023 registered at Police Station Moti Nagar, district Sagar, for an offence punishable under Sections 304B, 498A of IPC R/w 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 26.10.2023 and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
He further submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
The applicant is a permanent resident of district and there is no likelihood of her absconding or tampering with prosecution evidence.
She is ready to furnish adequate surety and shall abide by all the conditions to be imposed by the Court.
Upon these grounds, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
In this case, the wife of applicant died of consuming poisonous substance on 05.10.2023.
The statements of father of deceased recorded during merg inquiry reveal that the deceased was being harassed and treated with cruelty by the applicant for demand of Rs.1 Lakh in dowry.
Dulichand, the father of deceased has claimed that he too had talks with applicant about this demand.
Victim died within seven years of her marriage.

The application has been argued on the ground that there is no statement regarding demand of dowry and cruelty committed with the deceased soon before her death, but the statement of witnesses reveal that applicant used to refuse the victim to go to her maternal house and in seven years of marriage she came to her parental house only twice and on every occasion she narrated the fact of demand of dowry and cruelty.

6. Having considered these facts, the bail application is dismissed.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE rv Sagar Baor (Bansal ) vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/190501814/
